items.t: Front lower ball joint wear and separation
items.job: Replace front lower ball joints
items.note: Price covers both sides. Recalls covered many 2002-2006 joints, so check your VIN. Alignment may be extra.

items.t: Front upper ball joint can separate (salt-belt recall)
items.job: Replace both front upper control arms
items.note: Covered free under recall for affected salt-belt vehicles. Check your VIN. The ball joint comes built into the arm.

items.t: Rear lower control arms crack from rust
items.job: Replace both rear lower control arms
items.note: Recalls covered many 2004-2007 vehicles. Check your VIN before paying. Rusted bolts can add time.

items.t: Airbags can go off without a crash
items.job: Replace airbag control module or add recall jumper harness
items.note: Covered free under recall for affected vehicles. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Fuel tank can leak in a rear crash
items.job: Inspect rear structure and install factory tow hitch
items.note: Free inspection and hitch work under recall 13V-252. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Power window regulator failure
items.job: Replace window regulator and motor
items.note: Price is per door. The regulator and motor are usually sold as one unit.

items.t: Dropped valve seat on the 3.7L V6
items.job: Replace engine with a used or remanufactured unit
items.note: A used engine sits at the low end; a new 3.7L crate engine is about $3,900 (Quadratec). Book time is about 10.7 hours for a complete engine and 14.7 hours for a long block (2CarPros). If caught early, a cylinder head repair may cost less.

items.t: Park may not hold (park pawl recall)
items.job: Inspect transmission and install park pawl retaining bracket
items.note: Covered free under recall for affected vehicles. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Active head restraint faults (recalls)
items.job: Update TIPM software or replace occupant restraint controller
items.note: Covered free under recall for affected vehicles. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Steering column pivot rivet may be missing
items.job: Inspect steering column and repair pivot rivet
items.note: Free inspection and repair under recall 11V-315. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Brake line and booster pushrod recalls
items.job: Replace brake tubes and booster input rod clip
items.note: Covered free under recall for affected vehicles. Check your VIN or ask a Jeep dealer.

items.t: Sky Slider canvas roof leaks and jams
items.job: Replace Sky Slider folding top frame (tracks and cables)
items.note: Mopar frame 68055315AF lists at $2,050 MSRP ($1,378 discounted, without motor); availability may be limited since the original supplier closed. One owner was told removing the top takes about 4 hours. Owner-reported totals run about $900-$3,200 (dealer quotes $2,800-$3,200); smaller fixes such as a canvas top or control module can cost less.

items.t: Integrated power module (TIPM) faults
items.job: Replace or rebuild the integrated power module (TIPM)
items.note: Parts: sending the original module to a repair service runs about $200-$350 (youcanic); a Dorman remanufactured module listed for the 2008 Liberty is about $738 plus a core deposit (FinditParts). Confirm the part number by VIN, since modules vary by year. No published book time was found; youcanic puts shop totals at about $500 to over $1,000, and some modules need dealer programming.

items.t: Automatic transmission slips or fails
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with a remanufactured unit
items.note: Parts: a remanufactured 42RLE listed for the 2005 Liberty 3.7L is about $2,720 with core return (Powertrain Company); Jerry puts parts for a 2004 Liberty at about $4,100-$4,400. Labor: no book time was found; hours are set from Jerry's labor figure of about $1,200-$1,300. Jerry total: about $5,300-$5,700. A solenoid or fluid service costs far less if that turns out to be the problem.

items.t: Radiator cracks and leaks coolant
items.job: Replace radiator and refill coolant
items.note: Parts: a TRQ radiator for the 2002-2006 Liberty 3.7L is about $112 at 1A Auto; YourMechanic's average parts figure is $344. Labor: no book time was found; hours are set from YourMechanic's average labor of about $252. YourMechanic per-year estimates for 2002-2007 3.7L models: about $984-$1,107 total. The 2.8L diesel costs more.

items.t: Water pump leaks or fails
items.job: Replace water pump and gasket, refill coolant
items.note: Parts: aftermarket 3.7L pumps from about $61 (Walmart/Parts Geek); Mopar pump 53022189AH is $273 MSRP ($181 discounted) plus a $22-$32 gasket. Labor: no book time was found; hours are set so totals match RepairPal's $521-$722 Liberty estimate. KBB general range: $375-$787. Replacing the belt and thermostat at the same time adds a little.

items.t: A/C compressor or clutch fails
items.job: Replace A/C compressor, receiver dryer and orifice tube, then recharge
items.note: Based on YourMechanic's Liberty average: about $615 parts and $392 labor (about 3 hours), including the dryer and orifice tube. No parts-retailer price could be fetched. RepairPal year estimates run about $506-$979; YourMechanic's own per-year quotes are higher at $1,727-$2,085. A clutch-only repair or leak fix can cost less.

items.t: Blower fan works only on high speed
items.job: Replace blower motor resistor
items.note: YourMechanic: about $114 average ($19 parts, $95 labor); per-year estimates $134-$222. No parts-retailer price could be fetched. If the blower motor itself is worn, that is a separate, larger repair.

items.t: Oil pressure sensor leaks or breaks
items.job: Replace oil pressure sensor or switch
items.note: YourMechanic: about $160 average ($20 parts, $140 labor); per-year estimates $187-$217 for gas engines and about $291 for the 2.8L diesel. No parts-retailer price could be fetched. Top up any lost oil.

items.t: Front wheel bearing hums or growls
items.job: Replace front hub and bearing assembly (one side)
items.note: Parts for 2002-2007: aftermarket hub about $57 (Walmart), Crown about $88 (Quadratec), Timken HA599455L about $165 (Home Depot). Labor: no book time was found; hours are set from YourMechanic's 2005-2007 front bearing estimates of about $532-$747 per side. Price is per side.
